ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

power_domains_summary.PCD_AVDD: Analog supply for PCD oscillator / TX modulator / RX envelope detector (typ 3.3 V).
power_domains_summary.PCD_DVDD: Digital supply for PCD logic (typ 3.3 V or 1.8 V).
power_domains_summary.PCD_PVDD: Pad / antenna driver supply (typ 3.3 V to 5 V depending on antenna power requirement).
power_domains_summary.PCD_HOST_BUS_VDD: Host bus I/O supply (3.3 V or 1.8 V LVCMOS per host MCU).
power_domains_summary.PICC_VCC_INTERNAL: PICC field-rectified VCC (typ 1.8 V); generated on-chip from the RF carrier — no external power pin.

power_up_sequence: 1. Host MCU applies AVDD / DVDD / PVDD to PCD reader chip.
2. Host MCU releases NRSTPD (or asserts then releases per chip convention).
3. PCD chip boots in disabled / field-off state.
4. Host MCU configures PCD chip (TxControl, RxThreshold, ModWidth, CRC enable, bit rate).
5. Host MCU commands PCD to turn on antenna driver — RF carrier appears.
6. PCD waits ≥ 5 ms for any PICC POR before first REQA / REQB.
7. PICC: rectifier output rises with field envelope; internal POR releases at VCC_internal ≥ 1.6 V (typ); OTP loads; PICC enters IDLE.
power_down_sequence: 1. Host MCU commands PCD to turn off antenna driver — RF carrier disappears.
2. PICC: rectifier output falls below POR threshold within ≤ 1 ms; all PICC state lost.
3. Host MCU may assert NRSTPD or remove DVDD/AVDD to fully power-down PCD chip.

low_power_modes_summary.PCD_field_off: PCD antenna driver disabled; no field; max power saving on PCD; PICC immediately powers down.
low_power_modes_summary.PCD_doze: Vendor-specific PCD low-power mode with reduced polling cadence (REQA every ~ 100 ms instead of continuous).
low_power_modes_summary.PCD_host_bus_suspend: Host MCU asserts NRSTPD; PCD chip current ≤ 10 μA typical.
low_power_modes_summary.PICC_HALT: PICC ignores REQA but still consumes field-powered standby current; only WUPA wakes it.
low_power_modes_summary.PICC_T_CL_inactive: PICC in T_CL_ACTIVE between commands consumes nominal Layer-4 current; PCD may issue S(DESELECT) to drop to HALT for lower current.

power_consumption_typical.PICC_field_powered_µA: 5..20 (idle / HALT) ; up to 1 mA during EEPROM write on MIFARE Classic / Ultralight / NTAG
power_consumption_typical.PICC_DESFire_mA: Up to 2..3 during AES authentication and 32-bit write

field_strength_for_power_budget.operating_envelope_per_class: Class 1 antenna: 0..100 mm; Class 2/3/4: progressively reduced operating volume per ISO 10373-6.

fields.notes: Power intent is asymmetric: PCD requires DC power and active control; PICC requires only an RF field. There is no PICC-side power switch or sleep register exposed on the air interface — the PCD modulates PICC power by controlling the field. Battery-assisted PICCs exist (e.g. NTAG I2C plus, battery-assist contactless smartcards) but are outside the ISO 14443 power scope. The PICC's CID field in T=CL has a 2-bit POWER subfield (PCB byte 4..5) that can carry battery-level information for power-aware PCDs, but most contemporary PICCs leave it as 'card not powered'.
